Falco monitors syscalls INSIDE containers. kubectl API calls do NOT go through container syscalls. Think about how to get data WITHOUT exec-ing into a container.
The flag is in a ConfigMap called 'evasion-reward' in namespace 'dojo-sec-evasion'. You can read ConfigMaps directly via kubectl — no container exec needed.
kubectl get configmap evasion-reward -n dojo-sec-evasion -o jsonpath='{.data.flag}'
